tasks.label: pi: sync and restart
tasks.detail: ⌃⌘B — rsync to the Pi, restart the service, show status
tasks.command: rsync -av --delete --exclude='.git' --exclude='__pycache__' --exclude='*.pyc' --exclude='.DS_Store' --exclude='_to_delete' --exclude='.vscode' --exclude='venv' --exclude='.venv' --exclude='logs' --exclude='hailo-tracker.env' --exclude='events.db' --exclude='events.db-wal' --exclude='events.db-shm' --exclude='snapshots' --exclude='*.hef' ${workspaceFolder}/ pi5-0:~/hailo-tracker/ && ssh pi5-0 'sudo systemctl restart hailo-tracker && sleep 1 && systemctl status hailo-tracker --no-pager -l | head -20'

tasks.label: pi: sync
tasks.detail: ⌃⌘S — rsync to the Pi only — never touches the running service

tasks.label: pi: clean sync and restart
tasks.detail: ⌃⌘⇧B — drop stale bytecode on the Pi, then sync and restart
tasks.command: ssh pi5-0 'cd ~/hailo-tracker && find . -name __pycache__ -type d -exec rm -rf {} + 2>/dev/null || true' && rsync -av --delete --exclude='.git' --exclude='__pycache__' --exclude='*.pyc' --exclude='.DS_Store' --exclude='_to_delete' --exclude='.vscode' --exclude='venv' --exclude='.venv' --exclude='logs' --exclude='hailo-tracker.env' --exclude='events.db' --exclude='events.db-wal' --exclude='events.db-shm' --exclude='snapshots' --exclude='*.hef' ${workspaceFolder}/ pi5-0:~/hailo-tracker/ && ssh pi5-0 'sudo systemctl restart hailo-tracker'

tasks.label: pi: run in foreground
tasks.detail: ⌃⌘⇧R — sync, stop the service, run it here. Prefer the 'pi: run' terminal profile: Ctrl-C there reaches the SIGINT handler that flushes the event log, instead of VS Code asking to kill the task.
tasks.command: rsync -av --delete --exclude='.git' --exclude='__pycache__' --exclude='*.pyc' --exclude='.DS_Store' --exclude='_to_delete' --exclude='.vscode' --exclude='venv' --exclude='.venv' --exclude='logs' --exclude='hailo-tracker.env' --exclude='events.db' --exclude='events.db-wal' --exclude='events.db-shm' --exclude='snapshots' --exclude='*.hef' ${workspaceFolder}/ pi5-0:~/hailo-tracker/ && ssh -t pi5-0 'sudo systemctl stop hailo-tracker; cd ~/hailo-tracker && python3 hailo_tracker.py'

tasks.label: pi: restart service
tasks.detail: ⌃⌘I — restart on the Pi, no sync
tasks.command: ssh pi5-0 'sudo systemctl restart hailo-tracker && sleep 1 && systemctl status hailo-tracker --no-pager -l | head -20'

tasks.label: pi: stop service
tasks.detail: ⌃⌘X — stop the service, freeing /dev/hailo0 for a foreground run
tasks.command: ssh pi5-0 'sudo systemctl stop hailo-tracker; systemctl is-active hailo-tracker || true'

tasks.label: pi: status
tasks.detail: ⌃⌘⇧U — unit status plus what the tracker thinks it is doing
tasks.command: ssh pi5-0 'systemctl status hailo-tracker --no-pager -l | head -30; echo; curl -s http://localhost:8080/stats | python3 -m json.tool | head -40'

tasks.label: pi: list cameras
tasks.detail: ⌃⌘M — what libcamera sees, and what the tracker enumerates

tasks.label: pi: get events csv
tasks.detail: ⌃⌘L — pull the event log off the Pi into logs/

tasks.label: pi: run tests (local)
tasks.detail: ⌃⌘T — off-device harness on this Mac: two fake cameras, fake NPU

tasks.label: pi: run tests (on the Pi)
tasks.detail: ⌃⌘⇧T — sync, then run the same harness on the Pi
